record.label: Same-feature endpoint-action q-head fine-tune
record.summary: Autonomous endpoint fine-tuning of the same 6,022 q-head parameters selects epoch4 at inner MSE 3.154637973e-8, only ratio 0.9988280 against the frozen head's 3.158339528e-8 and short of the required 0.99. It adds no inference FLOPs, but protected40 remained unopened because the information-limited gate failed.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed for endpoint fine-tuning with the unchanged q-head features; reopen only after a genuinely new source feature bank exists.
